intro.title: Map & Plan Labeling
intro.subtitle: IELTS Listening — Section 2 — Question Type
intro.description: In this question type, you listen to a description of a place (a campus, town, building, park, etc.) and label locations on a map or plan. The speaker gives directions using prepositions, movement verbs, and landmarks.
format: You see a map or plan with some locations already labeled
Several locations are numbered but unnamed
You listen to a monologue (usually a tour guide or orientation speaker)
Three sub-types: (1) Choose the correct letter — identify where places are on a map, (2) Choose the correct label from a word list (more words than gaps), (3) Write up to three words to label places
tips: Read all the labels and look at the map BEFORE the audio plays
Identify the starting point — the speaker usually says 'You are here' or 'Start at the entrance'
Follow the speaker's route — don't jump ahead on the map
Listen for direction words: left, right, straight, past, opposite
Watch out for distractors — the speaker may mention a place then correct themselves
The questions follow the order of the audio — if you miss one, move on
Maps can show streets, building layouts (indoor), or parks/camps — not just roads. Predict what kind of vocabulary you'll hear based on the map type
During preparation time, study the map and try to predict the direction language you'll hear for each gap

visualVocab.example: Go straight on past the park.
Go past the library on your left.
The café is next to the bookshop.
The bank is opposite the post office.
Take the second exit at the roundabout.

visualVocab.vi: rẽ trái ở ngã rẽ thứ hai
visualVocab.example: Take the second left after the bridge.

visualVocab.vi: rẽ phải ở ngã rẽ thứ hai
visualVocab.example: Take the second right and it's on your left.
Turn right at the traffic lights.
The shop is between the bank and the café.
There's a car park in front of the building.
The garden is behind the main building.
The pharmacy is at the corner of High Street.
Cross the road and it's on your right.
The shop is just past the zebra crossing.

vocabulary.en: On the other side of something; directly facing.
vocabulary.ex: "The café is opposite the library."

vocabulary.en: In the space separating two things.
vocabulary.ex: "The shop is between the bank and the post office."

vocabulary.en: Immediately beside; right next to.
vocabulary.ex: "The gym is next to the swimming pool."

vocabulary.en: At the back of something.
vocabulary.ex: "The car park is behind the main building."

vocabulary.en: Directly before or ahead of something.
vocabulary.ex: "There is a fountain in front of the entrance."

vocabulary.en: At the side of; next to.
vocabulary.ex: "The new café is beside the old bookshop."

vocabulary.en: On the far side of; past.
vocabulary.ex: "The sports field is beyond the car park."

vocabulary.en: Close beside; along the side of.
vocabulary.ex: "There's a path alongside the river."

vocabulary.en: On the opposite side from.
vocabulary.ex: "The pharmacy is across from the bus stop."

vocabulary.en: Not far away from; close to.
vocabulary.ex: "The toilets are near the main entrance."

vocabulary.en: Not far from; a short distance away.
vocabulary.ex: "The information desk is close to the entrance."

vocabulary.en: Where two streets or walls meet.
vocabulary.ex: "The pharmacy is at the corner of High Street and Park Road."

vocabulary.en: At the outer boundary of an area.
vocabulary.ex: "The park is on the edge of the town centre."

vocabulary.en: At the central point of an area.
vocabulary.ex: "There's a pond in the middle of the park."

vocabulary.en: On the left when facing forward.
vocabulary.ex: "The reception is on the left-hand side."

vocabulary.en: On the right when facing forward.
vocabulary.ex: "You'll see the café on the right-hand side."

vocabulary.en: A public green area in a town for recreation.
vocabulary.ex: "The park is on the left after the roundabout."

vocabulary.en: A large natural flow of water through a landscape.
vocabulary.ex: "Cross the river using the footbridge."

vocabulary.en: A small body of still water, often in a park.
vocabulary.ex: "There's a pond in the middle of the park."

vocabulary.en: A place where two roads cross each other.
vocabulary.ex: "Turn right at the crossroads."

vocabulary.en: A marked area on a road for pedestrians to cross safely.
vocabulary.ex: "The shop is just past the zebra crossing."

vocabulary.en: A doctor's office (British English — very common in IELTS listening).
vocabulary.ex: "Go past the surgery on your left."

vocabulary.en: Change direction to the left.
vocabulary.ex: "Turn left at the traffic lights."

vocabulary.en: Change direction to the right.
vocabulary.ex: "Turn right after the supermarket."

vocabulary.en: Continue forward without turning.
vocabulary.ex: "Go straight until you reach the roundabout."

vocabulary.en: Move beyond something without stopping.
vocabulary.ex: "Go past the library and it's on your right."

vocabulary.en: Go through an area or entrance.
vocabulary.ex: "Pass through the gate and into the courtyard."

vocabulary.en: Continue in the same direction.
vocabulary.ex: "Carry on along the corridor."

vocabulary.en: Move in the direction of something.
vocabulary.ex: "Head towards the main building."

vocabulary.en: Go from one side to the other.
vocabulary.ex: "Cross the bridge and turn left."

vocabulary.en: Move in a line beside or following something.
vocabulary.ex: "Walk along the river until you see the café."

vocabulary.vi: rẽ ở ngã rẽ đầu tiên
vocabulary.en: Turn at the first available road or path.
vocabulary.ex: "Take the first turning on your left."

vocabulary.en: Keep going in the same direction.
vocabulary.ex: "Continue past the shops and you'll see it."

vocabulary.en: Make a sudden, tight turn to the left.
vocabulary.ex: "Take a sharp left after the traffic lights."

vocabulary.en: A door, gate, or opening for going in.
vocabulary.ex: "The main entrance is on Park Street."

vocabulary.en: A way out of a building or area.
vocabulary.ex: "The emergency exit is at the back."

vocabulary.en: The area where visitors are greeted.
vocabulary.ex: "Go to reception to collect your pass."

vocabulary.en: A long passageway inside a building.
vocabulary.ex: "Walk down the corridor to the last door."

vocabulary.en: A point where two or more roads meet.
vocabulary.ex: "Turn left at the junction."

vocabulary.en: A place where two roads cross each other.
vocabulary.ex: "The café is just past the intersection."

vocabulary.en: A circular junction where traffic flows in one direction.
vocabulary.ex: "Take the second exit at the roundabout."

vocabulary.en: A path designed only for people walking.
vocabulary.ex: "Follow the pedestrian walkway to the lake."

vocabulary.en: An area for parking cars.
vocabulary.ex: "The car park is behind the shopping centre."

vocabulary.en: A narrow path for walking.
vocabulary.ex: "Take the footpath through the park."

vocabulary.en: The principal road through an area.
vocabulary.ex: "The hotel faces the main road."

vocabulary.en: A structure built over a river or road.
vocabulary.ex: "Cross the bridge and turn right."

vocabulary.en: Signals that control traffic flow at junctions.
vocabulary.ex: "Turn right at the traffic lights."

vocabulary.en: A road with no exit at one end.
vocabulary.ex: "Don't go down there — it's a dead end."

vocabulary.en: In the direction of north on a map.
vocabulary.ex: "The lake is to the north of the campus."

vocabulary.en: In the direction of south on a map.
vocabulary.ex: "The car park is to the south."

vocabulary.en: In the direction of east on a map.
vocabulary.ex: "The sports hall is to the east of the library."

vocabulary.en: In the direction of west on a map.
vocabulary.ex: "The main gate is to the west."

vocabulary.en: Directly in front of you.
vocabulary.ex: "Go straight ahead and it's the third building."

vocabulary.en: A short distance after passing something.
vocabulary.ex: "The office is just past the reception desk."

vocabulary.en: Located at a point before reaching a landmark.
vocabulary.ex: "The toilets are before you get to the stairs."

vocabulary.en: At the furthest point of a path or corridor.
vocabulary.ex: "The lab is at the end of the corridor."

usefulPhrases.vi: Nó ở bên trái / phải của bạn.
usefulPhrases.usage: The most common way to indicate location during a tour or giving directions.
usefulPhrases.example: Walk past the entrance and it's on your left.

usefulPhrases.phrase: If you look at the map, you'll see...
usefulPhrases.vi: Nếu bạn nhìn vào bản đồ, bạn sẽ thấy...
usefulPhrases.usage: Speaker introduces a location on a map. Signals that the answer is coming next.
usefulPhrases.example: If you look at the map, you'll see the library is in the northeast corner.

usefulPhrases.phrase: You are here / We are here.
usefulPhrases.vi: Bạn đang ở đây / Chúng ta đang ở đây.
usefulPhrases.usage: Identifies the starting point on the map. Always listen for this first.
usefulPhrases.example: You are here, at the main entrance on Park Road.

usefulPhrases.phrase: As you come in through the entrance...
usefulPhrases.vi: Khi bạn đi vào qua lối vào...
usefulPhrases.usage: Common opening phrase when giving directions inside a building.
usefulPhrases.example: As you come in through the entrance, the reception desk is straight ahead.

usefulPhrases.usage: Indicates something is on the opposite side of an area.
usefulPhrases.example: The tennis courts are on the far side of the sports centre.

usefulPhrases.phrase: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
usefulPhrases.vi: Rẽ ở lối ra thứ hai tại vòng xuyến.
usefulPhrases.usage: Common instruction for outdoor map directions involving a roundabout.
usefulPhrases.example: At the roundabout, take the second exit onto Hill Road.

usefulPhrases.phrase: Follow the path / road until you reach...
usefulPhrases.vi: Đi theo con đường cho đến khi bạn đến...
usefulPhrases.usage: Instruction to keep going until reaching a landmark.
usefulPhrases.example: Follow the path until you reach the lake.

usefulPhrases.phrase: It's the first / second building on the left / right.
usefulPhrases.vi: Đó là tòa nhà đầu tiên / thứ hai bên trái / phải.
usefulPhrases.usage: Pinpoints a specific building in a sequence.
usefulPhrases.example: It's the second building on the right after the car park.

usefulPhrases.phrase: You'll come to a junction / crossroads.
usefulPhrases.vi: Bạn sẽ đến một ngã tư / giao lộ.
usefulPhrases.usage: Signals that a decision point is ahead.
usefulPhrases.example: You'll come to a junction — turn left there.

usefulPhrases.vi: Thực ra, không, ý tôi là...
usefulPhrases.usage: A self-correction — the speaker changes their answer. This is a DISTRACTOR signal. Listen for the corrected answer.
usefulPhrases.example: The café is on the left — actually, no, I meant on the right.

usefulPhrases.vi: Xin lỗi, để tôi nói lại.
usefulPhrases.usage: Another distractor signal — the speaker restarts their direction. The SECOND answer is correct.
usefulPhrases.example: Turn left at... sorry, let me start again. Turn right at the bank.

usefulPhrases.usage: Indicates something is exactly on the other side.
usefulPhrases.example: The bookshop is directly across from the bus station.

usefulPhrases.vi: Bạn không thể bỏ lỡ nó.
usefulPhrases.usage: Speaker reassures that the location is easy to find. Often follows the key direction.
usefulPhrases.example: It's the big red building on the corner — you can't miss it.

usefulPhrases.usage: Indicates something is hidden or not immediately visible behind another landmark.
usefulPhrases.example: The garden café is tucked away behind the main hall.

usefulPhrases.vi: Đi về hướng bắc / nam / đông / tây.
usefulPhrases.usage: Compass-based direction, common in outdoor map descriptions.
usefulPhrases.example: Head north along the main road for about 200 metres.

usefulPhrases.phrase: You can also go that way, but it's quicker to...
usefulPhrases.vi: Bạn cũng có thể đi lối đó, nhưng nhanh hơn nếu...
usefulPhrases.usage: DISTRACTOR — the speaker mentions an alternative route but then gives the preferred one. The SECOND route is the answer.
usefulPhrases.example: You can also go straight on here, past the surgery, but it's quicker to drive down Main Street.

usefulPhrases.phrase: Instead of turning left, you need to turn right.
usefulPhrases.vi: Thay vì rẽ trái, bạn cần rẽ phải.
usefulPhrases.usage: DISTRACTOR — the speaker reverses a direction. Listen carefully — the corrected direction is the answer.
usefulPhrases.example: Instead of turning left at the park, turn right with the pond on your left.

usefulPhrases.phrase: That's on the right; there are shops on the left.
usefulPhrases.vi: Nó ở bên phải; có các cửa hàng bên trái.
usefulPhrases.usage: DISTRACTOR — the speaker mentions both left and right. Focus on which side the TARGET location is on, not the other landmarks.
usefulPhrases.example: The house is the second one after the bridge. That's on the right — there are shops on the left.
